title: musher runner self-test results
description: The document `musher runner self-test` writes to MUSHER_RESULTS_FILE (and stdout) inside an isolation guest. host-agent's deep canary parses it and maps each check to an isolation condition. Keys are camelCase and fixed with the canary; schemaVersion changes only when a key is removed or changes meaning. The command exits 0 whenever it wrote this document, failed checks included. See docs/runner-mode.md.

schemaVersion.description: The document's version; this schema describes version 1.

runnerVersion.description: The musher CLI version that ran the checks (semver; "dev" for an unreleased build).

buildEngine.description: buildkitd at --buildkit-host answers ListWorkers (`buildctl debug workers`) with at least one worker. Maps to BUILD_ENGINE_READY.

localBuild.description: A `FROM scratch` Dockerfile build with one copied file solves on buildkitd, exporting and pushing nothing. Maps to BUILD_ENGINE_READY.

apiEgress.description: TCP and a verified TLS handshake (system roots, SNI) to the host of --api-url (or MUSHER_API_URL, or api_url in the inputs file). Not ok when none is set. Maps to API_EGRESS.

registryEgress.description: TCP and a verified TLS handshake to --registry (or MUSHER_REGISTRY_HOST), port 443 unless given. Not ok when none is set. Maps to REGISTRY_EGRESS.

deniedEgress.description: TCP connects to 169.254.169.254:80, 10.0.0.1:443 and 100.64.0.1:443 (--deny-metadata, --deny-rfc1918, --deny-cgnat) all fail within 3s each; refused, unreachable and timed out all count as denied. Not ok if any connected; detail lists each. Maps to EGRESS_POLICY_ENFORCED.

scratch.description: A file written to the scratch directory (TMPDIR, default /scratch) reads back unchanged. Maps to SCRATCH_DISK.

detail.description: Words a person reads: the target, the worker list, the TLS version, why a probe was denied, the error, and how long it took. Never machine-parsed.
